actions.message: Record that peer sharing is prohibited. Keep the finding and its provenance within the authorized private scope; do not copy them into team-project artifacts.
Continue the authorized investigation using private evidence. Do not contact the team peer or transmit a paraphrase, hint, or derived recommendation based on the confidential finding.

decision: Do not send a peer message. No peer read is needed to resolve the explicit sharing restriction.
supportingFacts: The user explicitly prohibits sharing investigation contents and derived confidential findings with the team project.
The only useful finding comes from the private investigation; no independent public source supports it.
A fresh permitted index already establishes peer relevance and ordinary messaging eligibility, but neither grants permission to share restricted information.
All actions are proposals; no messages, writes, or external calls were performed.
